requirements.verifier_assertion: Top-level moviepy exposes KeyframeTrack (type), an easing submodule, and vfx.KeyframeMotion (type); KeyframeMotion is an Effect subclass. Covers test_outputs.py:127, 128, 129, 135.
moviepy.easing.EASINGS is a name->callable dict whose sorted keys equal the 32 documented names, len == 32, and every entry is callable. Covers test_outputs.py:144, 145, 147.
Every registered easing produces the frozen Penner-formula samples at p = 0.1..0.9 within 1e-9. Covers test_outputs.py:156.
Every easing satisfies f(0)==0 and f(1)==1 within 1e-12. Covers test_outputs.py:164, 165.
hold(0)==0, hold(0.999)==0, hold(1)==1 — jumps only at the very last moment. Covers test_outputs.py:171, 172, 173.
must_include: jumps to the final value only at the very last moment

requirements.verifier_assertion: Every ease_in_out_* is symmetric about 0.5 within 1e-9 and satisfies f(p)==1-f(1-p) on [0,1]. Covers test_outputs.py:183, 186.
For every family (quad, cubic, quart, quint, sine, expo, circ, back, elastic, bounce), f_in(p) == 1 - f_out(1-p) within 1e-9. Covers test_outputs.py:203.

ease_in_expo, ease_out_expo, and ease_in_out_expo hit their endpoints exactly, and inside the domain the formulas are pure powers of two (2**-9 at p=0.1, 1-2**-9 at p=0.9). Covers test_outputs.py:211, 212, 213, 214, 216, 217.
Elastic easings hit endpoints exactly and overshoot outside [0,1] mid-domain (out_elastic > 1, in_elastic < 0). Covers test_outputs.py:227-232, 234, 235.
get_easing: string -> EASINGS lookup (unregistered raises ValueError); callable -> returned as-is; other type -> TypeError. Covers test_outputs.py:242, 244.
Scalar linear track interpolates linearly between adjacent keyframes and clamps to first/last outside the timeline; times/values are tuples. Covers test_outputs.py:258, 259, 260, 261, 262, 263.

at the moment the effect is applied

requirements.verifier_assertion: KeyframeTrack constructor rejects eagerly on empty sequence, non-increasing times, inconsistent value types, and illegal easing name. must_include: bool is not a valid time

requirements.verifier_assertion: value_at(t) raises TypeError when t is not a number (e.g. a string). Covers test_outputs.py:405-406.

Implementation follows moviepy conventions (one file per effect, dataclass, apply via clip.with_effects([...])), does frame computation only, and adds no new third-party dependencies. Regression tests are added for both new and legacy code paths.
